bead.title: Add explicit-decline tests for commit-transition on postgres and objectlog
bead.description:
PROBLEM
PostgresBackend, PostgresRelationalBackend, and ObjectLogBackend all inherit CommitTransitionPort's Unavailable default via an empty `impl CommitTransitionPort for X {}` (crates/pqueue-postgres/src/lib.rs:904, crates/pqueue-postgres/src/relational.rs:3455, crates/pqueue-objectlog/src/lib.rs:1047). None of them has a single test proving this -- not even a negative one. This is a quick, independent stop-gap ahead of the fuller conformance-harness refactor (sibling epic beads): lock today's known-good "explicitly declines" state in as an asserted, checkable fact so a future silent regression (e.g. someone flips a capability flag to true without wiring real behavior) fails CI immediately.

PROPOSED FIX
Add one test per backend, following the existing `hot_projection_capabilities_are_explicit` convention (crates/pqueue-postgres/tests/hot_projection_queries.rs) that:
1. Asserts `commit_capabilities() == CommitCapabilities::default()` (all-false, `DurabilityClass::EventualApply`).
2. Calls commit_transition, explain_commit, and side_record and asserts each returns `Err(EngineError::Unavailable)`.

IN-SCOPE FILES
- crates/pqueue-postgres/tests/ (new test file or addition to an existing one, for both PostgresBackend and PostgresRelationalBackend)
- crates/pqueue-objectlog/tests/ (new test file or addition to an existing one)

OUT-OF-SCOPE
- Implementing real CommitTransitionPort behavior for any backend (separate epic).
- Folding this into the shared pqueue-conformance harness (sibling bead in this epic).
bead.acceptance:
1. `cargo test -p pqueue-postgres commit_transition_capabilities_are_explicit` passes for both PostgresBackend and PostgresRelationalBackend (or equivalently named tests covering both).
2. `cargo test -p pqueue-objectlog commit_transition_capabilities_are_explicit` passes.
3. `rg -n 'CommitCapabilities::default\(\)' crates/pqueue-postgres/tests crates/pqueue-objectlog/tests` finds the new assertions.
4. `cargo fmt --check` passes.
